Extract multiple Open Graph tags including type, url, and site_name

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><meta property=\"og:title\" content=\"Article Title\"><meta property=\"og:type\" content=\"article\"><meta property=\"og:url\" content=\"https://example.com/article\"><meta property=\"og:site_name\" content=\"Example Site\"><meta property=\"og:description\" content=\"An interesting article.\"><meta property=\"og:image\" content=\"https://example.com/article.jpg\"></head><body><article><p>Article content here.</p></article></body></html>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().document().openGraph())
```
